I · Profile and account

Onboarding spec
• Splash under 1.5 s. First launch goes to the intro; returning users go to Home.
• Intro: 3 swipeable cards, Skip on every card, auto-advance off.
• Sign in with phone and OTP (6 digits, autofill from SMS, resend after 30 s). Email sign-in for existing accounts.
• Practice setup is one screen. Plans are never chosen in the app; new accounts start on the trial set on the web.
Home spec
• Built around today's work: follow-ups due, scans in progress, drafts to finish.
• No plan or credit statistics on Home. Usage lives in Profile and on the web.
• Notifications: 3D ready, patient viewed report, follow-up due, video ready, study updated.
• Consent for scanning is required; consent for marketing use (videos, social) is a separate optional switch.
Patient spec
• Everything for a patient lives under their profile: Overview, Scans, Treatments, Reports, Videos, Consent and notes.
• Tabs scroll horizontally and stay pinned under the header.
• Scans show the region Edebo detected and the angle covered.
• Treatments link to the scans taken before and after them.
Scan spec
• No region picker. The backend detects face, hairline or body from the video.
• Coverage can be anything from 30° to 360°. Stop unlocks at 30°. The ring fills per 10°.
• Live checks: lighting, distance, subject found, steadiness.
• Warnings pause, never discard. Upload resumes after network loss and respects Wi-Fi only.
• Viewer: drag to rotate, pinch to zoom, two-finger pan, double-tap to reset.
Compare spec
• The layout follows how many scans are picked. 2: side by side, slider, overlay, heatmap. 3: one large view plus a strip. 4+: grid plus a timeline scrubber and trend chart.
• Only scans of the same patient and region can be compared.
• Rotation is linked. Heatmap needs 2 aligned scans.
Annotate spec
• The tool set changes with the detected region.
• Face: injection point, thread or vector, area, distance and angle, midline, text.
• Hairline: hairline curve, graft zone, temple point, distance, text.
• Body: circumference, marking pen, area, distance, text.
• Annotations save as layers and never change the scan.
Skin and reports spec
• A skin analysis uses the same allowance as one scan. Say so before confirming.
• Indices track change over time and always carry the disclaimer line.
• Reports are A4 PDF. Clinic letterhead needs the Premium brand kit.
Video spec
• Three types: 360° spin of one scan, before and after of two scans, progress across 3 or more.
• Formats 9:16, 1:1, 16:9. Clinic watermark on by default.
• Export is blocked until the patient's marketing consent is on.
• Posting to Instagram and YouTube needs connected accounts (Premium). Otherwise save or share via the system sheet.
Studies spec (Research Pro, Premium)
• A study groups patients with a similar treatment and lines up their scans by day since treatment.
• Patients are anonymised in study views and exports by default.
• Results show the cohort average with spread, plus each patient's change.
Profile spec
• Profile shows the doctor's practice: treatments done, scans by region, reports and videos shared.
• The app never takes payment. Plan, upgrades and invoices open the web dashboard.
• Locked features explain the plan needed and link to the web.

Consent and patient actions spec
• Consent is required before the first scan; marketing and research are optional and can be withdrawn.
• Patient signs on the doctor's phone or on their own phone via a link with OTP.
• Delete keeps data 30 days in Recently deleted, then removes it.
• Adding a treatment creates Day 14/30/90 follow-ups with WhatsApp reminders.
Patient-facing pages spec
• Report links do not expire; the clinic can turn a link off. Shown on the patient's phone browser, no login.
• Directory is Premium. [VERIFY] Directory scope: public doctor listing + enquiries, as drawn.
• Patient pages look the same on every plan.
Empty and failure spec
• Scans are saved on the phone until upload succeeds; credits are used only after processing succeeds.
• Processing failure explains why and offers rescan or using the usable part.

Web dashboard

Web dashboard spec
• All payments happen here: plan changes, scan top-ups, UPI AutoPay, cards, invoices with GST.
• Plans follow edebo.in: Starter has no annotation, reports or web dashboard. Pro adds annotation, reporting and analytics, limited web dashboard. Premium adds EMR (Medoc Health is the first partner), directory, social media integration, brand kit, Research Pro and the full dashboard. Clinics & platforms: 10 profiles × 4 devices.
• Scan limits are shown as multiples of Starter, never as credit counts.
• Scan viewer and Compare studio use WebGL with the full-resolution mesh.
• Breakpoints: 1280+ full layout; 768–1279 sidebar collapses to icons; under 768 one column.

User flows

How to read the flows
• Each box is clickable and opens that screen.
• Purple border: app screen. Black border: web page. Lilac fill: patient's phone. Dashed: backend or automatic step. Orange slant: decision. Black with yellow: plan gate.
• F0 lists what each plan unlocks.

Edebo · Foundations

How to read this file
• Pages: App · Premium (sample doctor, all features), App · Pro, App · Starter, App · Dark, Web · Premium, Web · Pro, Web · Starter, User flows, Foundations.
• Every phone frame is 390 × 844 pt. Taller frames scroll.
• Press Play on any light screen to click through the flow.
• Scan renders are real 3D models rendered for this file. Head: Lee Perry-Smith scan, CC BY 3.0 (Infinite Realities). Body: MakeHuman base mesh, CC0. Replace with Edebo's own consented scans before any public use.
• Names, dates and numbers are sample data.
• Logo is one colour: ink on light, off-white on dark. No yellow letter.
• Yellow only for primary actions and drag handles. Violet replaces grey.
• Sample doctor is on Premium so every feature is visible. Report share links do not expire.
• Copy rule: Edebo measures and tracks change. Never write diagnose or clinically valid.
